In [[Computability theory (computer science)|computability]] and [[Computational complexity theory|complexity theory]], '''ALL''' is the class of all [[decision problem]]s.

==Relations to other classes==
'''ALL''' contains all of the complex classes of decision problems, including '''[[RE (complexity)|RE]]''' and '''[[co-RE]]''', and uncountably many languages that are neither '''RE''' nor '''co-RE'''. It is the largest complexity class, containing all other complexity classes.
